rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a cool, self-controlled manner.

example.english: I calmly told them, “Take your time; don’t be afraid.”
example.traditional: 我冷靜咁同佢講：「你慢慢嚟，唔使驚。」
example.jyutping: ngo5 laang5 zing6 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 nei5 maan6 maan6 lai4 m4 sai2 geng1

rows.note: Use this when the manner is serene and unagitated rather than specifically self-controlled.

example.english: I calmly listened to the sound of the waves and drifted off to sleep.
example.traditional: 我平靜咁聽住海浪聲，唔知唔覺瞓着咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 zing6 gam2 teng1 zyu6 hoi2 long6 seng1 m4 zi1 m4 gok3 fan3 zoek6 zo2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for acting unflappably, especially in a surprising or stressful situation.

example.english: When the microphone suddenly stopped working during the livestream, they calmly carried on speaking.
example.traditional: 直播期間個咪突然冇聲，佢仲淡定咁繼續講。
example.jyutping: zik6 bo3 kei4 gaan1 go3 mai1 dat6 jin4 mou5 seng1 keoi5 zung6 daam6 ding6 gam2 gai3 zuk6 gong2
